turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
delivery times depend on the destination:

Portugal: 24 to 48 hours
Balearic Islands: 3 to 4 business days
Canary Islands: 5 to 7 business days
Most European destinations: 5 to 6 business days

Delivery times are counted in business days and can be slightly affected during busy periods.

Once the shipment is processed, you should receive tracking by SMS. You can also find more details in this form: https://masderm.com/policies/shipping-policy 🤝
